title: Ledup hero slider
description: A full-bleed photo hero that fills 80% of a phone screen and almost the whole desktop window, with big soft rounded bottom corners. A calm brown headline and one line of text sit low at the left, with numbered tabs (01, 02) under them; slides cross-fade every few seconds or on a tab click.
notes: each slide's media fills the frame like object-fit: cover; empty shows a grey placeholder
the headline is ink-coloured, so it needs a light photo behind it, as on the original
auto-advance is off under reduced motion; needs JavaScript (hydrate: load), the static HTML shows the first slide
name: ledup-hero

props.name: interval
props.description: seconds each slide stays before the next one fades in (0 = no auto-advance)

props.name: tabLabel
props.description: screen-reader label for a tab, followed by its number ("Show slide")
